definitions.explanation: Relating to the public sphere, government, or matters open to general knowledge. Contrasts with private or unofficial matters.

examples.japanese: {公|おおやけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{公|おおやけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That information has not been made public yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私的|してき}→私的：06350_shiteki⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公|おおやけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧べきで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I don't think private matters should be made public.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公|おおやけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (make public, disclose)
- {公|おおやけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (become public, come to light)
- {公|おおやけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (public setting, official venue)
- {公|おおやけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧ (official position)

USAGE:
The やま⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (native Japanese word) for "public," contrasting with the sino-Japanese {公|こう} used in compounds like ⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧ (public), ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧ (official). {公|おおやけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to make public" or "to disclose," while {公|おおやけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ means "to become publicly known." The word implies visibility to society at large and often carries a sense of formality or officialness.
